# Check helper references at the landing rather than trusting a removal title

All thirteen deleted helper names occur only at their definitions in their immediate parent revisions under mail/mailnews, and none remain at the accepted endpoint within those paths. This supports the bounded unused-helper cleanup. It does not prove no dynamic caller ever exists or that marking messages, deleting books, editing tables or saving documents ceased to be product features. Keep static reference scope and operation ownership separate. These observations are scoped to the cited accepted source and historical changes. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline/inline discussion remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check was run.

Scope: mail/test/browser.
